div.div: split_size — shared configuration, not a parent field

switch.text: split_size — shared configuration, not a parent field

g.text: - All channel buffers contain consecutive samples, without headers.
- Timestamp applies to sample 0 in every participating channel.
- Final segment: L bytes, where 0 < L ≤ split_size.
- Segment i start address = address[channel] + i × split_size
- Address arrows identify each buffer’s first byte; buffers need not be adjacent.
